descriptors.definition: An exempt supply comprises any goods, services, or both attracting a nil tax rate, full exemption, or non-taxable status under governing statutes. This classification includes items and services not leviable to tax under the primary legislative acts.
inclusion: supplies attracting nil rate of tax
non-taxable supplies including specified petroleum products and alcoholic liquor
exclusion: taxable supplies subject to standard or reduced positive rates
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes between wholly exempt items and non-taxable supplies which are both subsumed under exempt supply definitions

descriptors.concept_name: Power to Grant Exemption from Tax
descriptors.definition: The Government may issue notifications or special orders on council recommendations to exempt specific goods or services from whole or part of taxes in the public interest. Registered suppliers must not collect tax exceeding the effective rate on absolutely exempted supplies.
inclusion: explanations inserted within one year to clarify scope
exclusion: collection of tax in excess of effective rates on absolute exemptions
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes general notifications applied broadly from special orders issued for exceptional individual cases

descriptors.definition: Specified everyday consumption items are exempted from the whole of tax under statutory exemption powers. These include essential public consumption products notified under governing tax legislation.
inclusion: unbranded or unpackaged staple food items
fresh vegetables and specified raw agricultural produce
exclusion: processed or branded items outside the exemption notification
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes raw or unpackaged essential food items from processed commercial goods subject to standard taxation

descriptors.concept_name: List of Services Exempt From Tax
descriptors.definition: Specific categories of services rendered by qualified entities, such as charitable activities and religious ceremonies, are exempted wholly from central tax under designated notifications. Certain monetary thresholds apply to determine the applicability of exemptions on renting properties and premises.
inclusion: religious ceremonies and eligible renting of religious precincts
training or coaching in arts, culture, or sports by specified entities
exclusion: renting of rooms with daily charges meeting or exceeding specified monetary thresholds
renting of commercial shops exceeding monthly rental limits
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes general commercial service providers from charitable trusts and religious institutions qualifying for specific service exemptions

descriptors.concept_name: Power Not to Recover Tax Not Levied or Short-Levied Due to General Practice
descriptors.definition: The Government may direct that uncollected or short-levied tax need not be paid if a specific industry practice of non-levy or lower levy was generally prevalent. This relief mechanism protects taxpayers who followed widespread customary practices in good faith upon council recommendations.
inclusion: supplies where central tax was not levied due to prevalent general practice
supplies charged at a lower rate in accordance with established industry customs
exclusion: tax non-payment resulting from isolated taxpayer errors unsupported by general trade practice
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes regular statutory exemptions from retroactive relief granted specifically for widespread industry misinterpretations or customary practices
